rule_outs: Dwelling 10 m from the best section
summary: Flat dip in a quiet residential kerb; homes about 15-25 m on its side.

drivers.seclusion: Bush across the road, but houses and front yards about 15-25 m east on the kerb's own side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with cars parked on both sides; room for a van at the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street; light through traffic.
drivers.convention: 2P Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted; cars park along both sides.

flags: Slope is flat in the dip (about 2%), but 16% mean along the full stretch
Homes within about 25 m on the kerb's side
Mapped gate 18 m away has a way round
sun_shade: Mostly open over the east kerb; bush shades the west side, so morning sun reaches the van.

best_section.where: Woodstock Avenue east kerb, in the dip opposite the bushland
